item.title: Letter: UNCA chancellor is wrong about so much

item.title: Letter: NIMBYs won’t face practical realities
item.description: "They are unwilling to bear the marginal costs of development close to them, and by doing so unwittingly promote the creation of suburban sprawl that is ultimately far worse for the environment and the community."

item.title: Letter: Fund abortions before child care
item.description: "Abortions and contraception are what a place must fund to build economic infrastructure, before funding child care, schools or maternity care."
